name: Western European Union (1993–1995)
description: A dark blue field with a semicircle of ten yellow five-pointed stars around the white letters 'WEU' and 'UEO' arranged in a cross.
history: The first flag of the Western European Union, introduced in 1993 after the Maastricht Treaty made the WEU the defence arm of the European Union: the initials of the organisation in English and French on the blue of Europe within a half-circle of stars for the member states. It was replaced in 1995 by the flag with the stars alone.

features.role: letters WEU and UEO in a cross
